newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-SPORTING CUT PORTO LEAGUE LEAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SPORTING CUT PORTO LEAGUE LEAD.

text.p: Sporting cut Porto's lead at the top of the Portuguese league to four points on Saturday when they came from behind to beat 10-man Guimaraes 4-1.
Porto have the chance to restore their advantage when they meet Oporto city rivals Boavista on Sunday.
Guimaraes, who travelled to Lisbon unbeaten in nine games, took an early lead when defender Quim Berto scored from a free kick after 16 minutes.
But Sporting levelled after 27 minutes with captain Oceano Cruz converting a penalty awarded after striker Pedro Barbosa had been brought down by Berto.
Guimaraes were reduced to 10 men after winger Nuno Capucho was dismissed for protesting the penalty decision and from then on the Lisbon team took control.
Cruz scored a second with a header and the other goals came from substitute strikers Jose Dominguez and Paulo Alves who had come on in the second half.
